text: Built a Generative Adversarial Network in TensorFlow that reconstructs high-quality, photorealistic frames from noisy, low-sample path-traced renders (4-8 samples/pixel vs. the 32K+ typically required)
Synthesized a training set of 1,000 samples from 40 Pixar-style images using Gaussian noise across a 5x5 grid of standard-deviation settings
Optimized adversarial, pixel, feature, and smoothness loss terms to improve reconstructed image quality (PSNR/SSIM)
